partner.name: Seared Fish Fillet
partner.desc: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2900~4200). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

partner.name: Ore-loving Beast
partner.desc: Improves the player's mining efficiency while riding Reptyro.

partner.name: Ice-loving Beast
partner.desc: Improves the player's mining efficiency while riding Reptyro Cryst.

partner.name: Night Dancer
partner.desc: Can be ridden. Increases movement speed while mounted at night.

partner.name: Light Dancer
partner.desc: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5~25% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)

partner.name: Invisible Eye

partner.name: Guardian Of The Snowy Mountain

partner.name: Guardian Of The Grassy Fields
partner.desc: Increases the player's max carrying capacity by a large amount while Wumpo Botan is on the team. Allows Wumpo Botan to be mounted.

partner.name: Grave Robber

partner.name: Unknown Intruder
partner.desc: Can be ridden. While in the team, you can obtain more Meteorite Fragments and Pure Quartz.

partner.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partner.desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, fishing minigames begin with the capture gauge more filled than usual. Additionally, the capture gauge increases more rapidly while the bars are overlapping.

partner.desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by 60~210% and Defense by 60~210% for a limited time.

partner.name: Plasma Dash

partner.name: Mist Stalwart
partner.desc: When activated, the player's attacks inflict Poison 2~6. While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

partner.name: Nightmare Stare

partner.name: Resonant Guardian
partner.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.
